```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`ntlgini` provides harmonized annual nighttime-light Gini coefficients and
Pyatt/Dagum decompositions (`within`, `between`, and `overlap`) across
administrative levels `ADM_1` to `ADM_4` for 228 countries and territories
from 1992 to 2024.

## 1. Exploring Country Coverage

The bundled `ntl_gini_countries` table summarizes which administrative levels
are available for each country:

```{r coverage}
library(ntlgini)

data("ntl_gini_countries", package = "ntlgini")
head(ntl_gini_countries, 10)
table(ntl_gini_countries$max_level)
```

## 2. Multi-Scale Inequality Evolution

For countries with four administrative levels (such as Tunisia or Morocco),
`ntl_gini_decomp()` reveals how inequality behaves differently across spatial
scales:

```{r multiscale}
tun <- ntl_gini_decomp(iso3 = "TUN", years = c(1992, 2010, 2024))
tun[, c("year", "level", "n_groups", "total_gini", "between_gini", "within_gini")]
```

## 3. Longitudinal Trends by Sensor Era

Because Cheng et al. (2026) transition from *NightNet*-reconstructed DMSP-OLS
(1992–2011) to native NPP-VIIRS (2012–2024), `ntl_gini_trends()` lets you fit
log-linear trends separately for each era:

```{r trends}
ntl_gini_trends(iso3 = c("TUN", "MAR"), level = "adm1", window = "viirs")
```
